title: Forsic harness acceptance inventory
notice: Original Pro scenarios plus references to implemented checks. Consult actual run receipts for execution results. No behavior score is inferred from test counts.

scenarios.title: 직접 읽기에서 미션 없이 grounded 현재 답
scenarios.preconditions: 새 합성 사건, owned session, optional mission 없음.
scenarios.synthetic_input: 요청 로그 한 줄과 그 의미를 묻는 질문. 정상 read 반환 C2/C1.

scenarios.expected_behavior: 필요한 본문을 읽고 요청 관측/실행 미확인을 구분해 현재 답을 저장한다.

scenarios.expected_behavior: 이미 읽은 내용을 재활용하고 의미 없는 반복에서 전략을 바꾼다.

interface_staging: Initial P1 keeps question_id/expected_revision and binds bulk closure to existing snapshot_id. question_ref is a conditional later alternative; operation_id is hidden only after trusted stable call identity is verified.
implementation_scope: P0-P4 contracts; P5 comparison preparation. Hermes remains the only operational engine.

behavior_protocol.authorization: Use only separately authorized behavior trials. Existing same-case recovery E2E is not an independent holdout.
fixed_conditions: source commit and native engine revision
model digest, quantization and serving version
tool schemas/pin, permissions and supported parsers
wall time, token and tool budgets
allowed external calls and supervisor policy
behavior_protocol.comparison: Vary one engine/adapter dimension at a time; do not change the model, context and tools together. No alternate engine is installed for this preparation.
record: input total/cached/new, output, compression and failed-call cost separately
supported scope, unreviewed material, final answer and reopening conditions
behavior_protocol.not_observed: Missing behavior remains not_observed. Draft errors are not final-use errors; unrelated calls and elapsed time are not failed correction opportunities.
behavior_protocol.acceptance: Review each scenario against its failure criteria and observed repair. No aggregate count, zero-error rule or semantic approval from schema validation.
behavior_protocol.engine_change_gate: First establish the authorized Hermes baseline. Consider another engine only if a remaining engine-level limitation is evidenced and controlled comparison improves useful investigation without weakening forensic contracts.

representative_preparation.contract_scope: Actual registered read/question/report handlers; provisional save, exact retained source citations, explicit scripted review receipts, atomic corrected answer/review response and current HTML/Word projection. No dispatch, evaluator, semantic scorer or model call.
representative_preparation.coverage_limit: Three small synthetic examples prepare manual evaluation; they do not exhaust the 24 mapped scenarios or establish autonomous performance. Partial JSONL parse failure is fixture data, not a new runtime parser test.
